messages:
sara: Quick heads up — community bake sale tomorrow morning. Can someone pick up oat milk, butter croissants, and bananas? I can reimburse. :raised_hands:

mike: I can swing by the bakery at 10:30. Butter or almond croissants?

sara: butter please. also we only have 1 almond milk box left so oat would be best.

jun: I have a pickup window at 11, I can take oat milk. Any GF/dairy notes I should flag?

anya: I can handle price tags and napkins. Quick poll: coffee at the table — espresso or drip?

mike: espresso for the win :espresso: (drip works if grinder is acting up)

sara: espresso then! @katie can you confirm the portafilter was cleaned? last week it got stuck :sweat_smile:

katie: cleaned this morning :white_check_mark: but we need a tamping brush. I'll leave a sticky note on the whiteboard.

snacks-bot: reminder set — "Community Bake Sale" tomorrow 09:00 AM.

jun: Picking up Oatly Barista + bananas. ETA ~11:15. Quick `buy list` I put in my notes:
```
- Oatly Barista 1L x2
- Butter croissants x12
- Bananas 1 bunch
- Small sugar packets x1 box
```

mike: Venmo ok for the bakery? I'll send payment to sara.

sara: yep venmo @sara-redwood, I'll drop receipt in the kitchen folder.

anya: also updating fridge note: "LABEL OPEN JARS + PUT LIDS BACK pls" — will write it in marker.

mike: can someone slap a sticky on the espresso hopper: "DO NOT ADJUST" — the intern tinkered with the grind last week :grimacing:

katie: sticky added. also put a backup pack of K-cups in the cabinet labeled 'coffee-emergency'.

sara: awesome, thanks everyone. See you tomorrow — I brought extra stickers for the price tags :cake:
